Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and helpful context on Novacorp's latency targets and the need to keep PII in-region for EU/APAC customers. Quick recap/high-level next steps so we can lock in the technical deep-dive:

- Goal: 90-minute technical deep-dive (solutions + infra + security touchpoints) to scope the Dedicated/Private options and routing policies.
- Suggested owners: Ben (solutions engineer) to lead demo; Vivek to confirm Dedicated capacity/ops questions.
- Ask from you: confirm which stakeholders will join (CTO/Platform/Infra) and preferred timezone windows.

To make scheduling straightforward across US / EU / APAC we put together a rotating-slot proposal (attached availability_matrix.xlsx) and a quick poll: https://doodle.com/poll/novacorp-deepdive-rotating-slots. The idea is a 3-week rotation so the meeting time moves each week to share the burden across regions. Example rotation (local times shown):

- Option A (Week 1): US morning (ET 9:00–10:30) / EU afternoon (15:00–16:30 CEST) / APAC evening (22:00–23:30 JST)
- Option B (Week 2): EU morning (10:00–11:30 CEST) / APAC afternoon (16:00–17:30 JST) / US late night (01:00–02:30 ET)
- Option C (Week 3): APAC morning (09:00–10:30 JST) / US afternoon (13:00–14:30 ET) / EU late evening (20:00–21:30 CEST)

If you prefer a single fixed window we can do that too — we just find rotating slots reduce scheduling friction for global teams. Can you both:

1) Confirm primary stakeholders who should attend (names + emails)
2) Mark availability on the poll and/or reply with preferred Option A/B/C and week(s) that work
3) Flag any hard constraints (e.g., John Park cannot be later than 16:00 CEST)

I've attached a short mutual action plan we can use to capture owners and deliverables once we lock the time. If it helps I can propose concrete calendar slots for next two weeks after you indicate the preferred option.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

Best,
